item.text: The notes present several distinct readings of what it means for effort to “be seen”: visible deeds, knowledge of deeds, and recompense. They also discuss the syntax of the passive and active readings, the clause’s link to the earlier scriptures, and several inward readings. I’m keeping the incidental literary examples in the map because the task requires every note to appear.
